description: What a grammar node calls its inputs, which Autark documents hold more than one view, and which write a key a node does not run, as the node and the backend decide it. inputTableNames: the name a node's input on each circle is read by. oneView: a document, and what it is told, named by its key in autkGrammar.json ("oneView"), or null for a document that draws one view or none. keys: a document, and the sentence it is told (autkGrammar.json's renamedKey or notRunYetKey, filled), or null for a document that writes no such key. Read by src/tests/contracts/autkGrammarCases.test.ts (inputTableName and autkOneViewProblem in contracts/autkGrammar.ts) and src/tests/contracts/autkGrammarKeys.test.ts (autkKeyProblem), and by backend/tests/test_agents/test_autk_grammar_cases.py (contracts.input_table_name and autk_one_view_problem, which the agents' document check uses) and test_autk_grammar_keys.py (autk_key_problem, which it uses too).
